Subject: Physical Infrastructure - Preparatory actions for Implementation ot
‘Modernization Project’ — Issue of consolidated Instructions

The second batch of 58 offices has been selected for implementation of the first

phase of the modernization project and actions have been initiated towards this end. The
successful implernentation of the project requires that the necessary physical
Infrastructure Is in place for the IT equipments installation and LAN cabling. The basic
physical infrastructure requirements for implementation of the~ project ‘have been
communicated to the respective offices.
2. This divisior-has been receiving requests for allocation of budget for carrying out
electrical cabling work from various offices, The infrastructure requirements were
discusseci in the weekly project review meeting taken by the CPFC 18-Jun-10. Apart from
the electrical cabling, the budgetary requirements for modular furniture, generator sets
ne and air conditioning was also taken up inthe meeting. After deliberation the following
¥ were agreed to-

(a) Electrieal-cabling requirements: it was decided that all electrical works that were
in the nature of alterations, a repair, enhancements or modification of existing
electrical works would be covered under review expenditure under the
maintenance budget head. New or additional requirements of electrical wiring
would be covered under original works and the relevant budget head. Each office ;
would prepare the proposals accordingly and the approvals and decisions would 2%
be taken as per existing delegation of powers and instructions in the matter.

Modular furniture: instructions have been Issued By the Physical Facilities
Division in this regard and respective offices:shall carry out the work as per these
instructions and seek necessary budget from PFD.

(c) Generator sets: necessary instructions have been issued by PFD and respective

offices shall take actions as per these instructions.

(d) Air-conditioning: proposals for air-conditioning will be sent by the respective
offices to the PFD and the sanctions would be conveyed after due procedure. Air-
conditioning-for the server rooms will be provided by the respective offices under
existing delegation of powers.

3. In the weekly review meeting under reference it was also decided that a
consolidated set of instructions on the infrastructure requirements would be issued by
PFD and the same would be reiterated by the project/IAS division and separate
communication. ee

4. It Is, accordingly, requested that instructions may be issued to the field offices on

the above matter under copy to this division.

(B.K. Panda)
